$comment: The clinic itself: who they are, how to reach them, when they open. Start here after site.json. Phone, WhatsApp and email links are built from the numbers below — write each number once.

identity.name: Demo
identity.shortDescription: Advanced dental care in a calm, modern clinic.
identity.longDescription: Demo Dental Clinic combines advanced technology with a gentle touch to deliver outstanding dental care in a warm, welcoming environment. Every treatment plan is built around one person: you.
identity.$logo: Optional. Leave src blank to use the built-in wordmark, drawn from identity.name and identity.suffix.

hero.title: Where healthy smiles begin.
hero.subtitle: Advanced dental care in a calm, modern clinic — with specialists who explain everything before they treat anything.

image.alt: Bright, modern dental treatment room with natural light

hero.$story: Opens from the 'Watch our story' button. Put an .mp4 in /public and set video.src to play it inline; leave it blank and the poster image is shown instead.

story.title: Our story
body: Demo Dental Clinic combines advanced technology with a gentle touch to deliver outstanding dental care in a warm, welcoming environment. Every treatment plan is built around one person: you.
We have treated patients from across Bangalore since 2009, and most of our new appointments still come from someone we have already looked after.

about.title: Personalised care. Exceptional results.
about.body: We combine advanced technology with a gentle touch to deliver outstanding dental care in a warm, welcoming environment — and we never treat anything we have not explained first.

portraitImage.alt: Dr. Aanya Mehta, founder and chief dentist

contact.$whatsappMessage: Pre-filled text for every WhatsApp link on the site.
contact.whatsappMessage: Hello Demo Dental Clinic, I'd like to book an appointment.

address.$geo: Used for the Dentist schema and the 'near me' signal Google reads. Right-click the pin in Google Maps to copy the coordinates.

$hours: `days` and `time` are what visitors read. `dayOfWeek`, `opens` and `closes` are what Google and the live 'Open now' pill read — keep them in sync, and use 24-hour times.

emergency.title: Emergency care, any hour
emergency.text: Severe pain, swelling or a knocked-out tooth? Our emergency line is answered day and night.

$socials: Use `href` for a profile URL, or `field` (phone, whatsapp, email) to link to a contact detail without repeating it.

smile.title: Your best smile is one visit away.
smile.text: Book a consultation and leave with a clear plan, a written estimate and no surprises.

ready.title: Ready to transform your smile?
ready.text: Book your appointment today and take the first step toward a healthier, brighter smile.

footer.blurb: Exceptional dental care in a calm, comfortable and caring environment — since {established}.
footer.$copyright: {year} is replaced with the current year, so this never goes stale.

seo.title: Demo Dental Clinic | Where healthy smiles begin
seo.description: Advanced dental care in Bangalore — implants, orthodontics, cosmetic dentistry and root canal therapy in a calm, hygienic, specialist-led clinic.
seo.$priceRange: Google shows this on the business panel. One to four currency symbols.
seo.$aggregateRating: Only fill this in if the clinic genuinely holds these reviews. Set value to 0 to omit the rating everywhere.
